platform: Mac host training; no Windows training
branch: public five-known benchmark K01-K05; no personal-photo branch

epochs_and_stopping.selection: For each width and initialization family choose the candidate with highest development macro utility after its threshold is fit only on threshold_calibration and unknown_calibration; tie-break by macro known accuracy then lower learning rate. Do not open final roles during search.
epochs_and_stopping.early_stopping: SurvFace stopping role only; restore the epoch with highest macro known stopping accuracy, tie-break by lower stopping loss. Olivetti uses its development role because the frozen small-data split has no separate stopping role.
epochs_and_stopping.scratch_fair_budget: For each width, scratch uses the same maximum total epoch count and batch/example budget as that width's selected transfer configuration. Every arm is independently initialized per registered root.
epochs_and_stopping.batching: Balanced six-class batches: four examples per K01-K05 and four OTHER examples per batch; 24 images, 15 steps per epoch, 360 sample presentations per full epoch. Unknown identities are sampled uniformly for OTHER batches.
epochs_and_stopping.augmentation: mild_gray_v1 is limited to training rows: deterministic seeded horizontal flip, gain U[0.92,1.08], and offset U[-8,8] gray levels. No validation/calibration/development/final augmentation.

survface_arms.head: K01-K05 logits; same unknown_train images used with uniform outlier-exposure loss
K01-K05 logits; same unknown_train images used with uniform outlier-exposure loss
K01-K05+OTHER logits
survface_arms.selection_control: quality/diversity sampling from the D training candidate pool

survface_arms.head: K01-K05+OTHER logits
survface_arms.selection_control: uniform sampling from the exact same D training candidate pool and camera-stratum budget

representation_comparisons.embedding: 64-D penultimate learned representation; L2 normalization in gallery builder
representation_comparisons.gallery: five known-identity galleries built only from training-role images; average 1, 3, 5, 10, or all available selected templates; template count and threshold chosen on calibration/development roles per root
representation_comparisons.selection_control: quality-ranked/diverse versus uniform five-template galleries, both evaluated over the same ten trained roots

representation_comparisons.embedding: existing v3 ten-root outputs only after per-file exposure and hash audit
representation_comparisons.adaptation: no encoder fine-tuning; D training-role image galleries are the only target-specific adaptation
representation_comparisons.classification: historical representation control, not a new independent D training arm

open_set_comparison.matched_input_information: Five-output and six-output models share the same known/unknown training image budget and the same train, stopping, threshold-calibration, development, and final roles. Six-output uses the unknown examples as OTHER-class supervision; five-output uses those exact unknown training examples with a uniform-distribution outlier-exposure loss and still emits only five known logits.
open_set_comparison.calibration: Use known threshold_calibration plus identity-disjoint unknown_calibration records. Select model-specific score thresholds on calibration roles to maximize correct known acceptance subject to unknown false-identification rate <= 5%; report the achieved risk even when the empirical constraint cannot be met.
open_set_comparison.unknown_test: unknown_final identities only; disjoint from unknown_train, unknown_calibration, and unknown_development identities.

quality_selection_control.source: B source_manifest/quality_inventory and permitted_survface_phashes; D-derived rows only; B manifests remain immutable.
quality_selection_control.candidate_pool: For K01-K05, include primary B train groups plus permitted, unassigned source groups. Exclude any exact/within-identity pHash component that touches B stopping/calibration/development/final/presentation roles. Exclude new candidate records connected by a cross-identity pHash<=6 edge to a frozen held-out role. Never read v3-final or unlabeled source files.
quality_selection_control.budget: 60 unique image groups per known identity; per-root camera-stratum counts match the B primary training strata. OTHER uses the exact same B unknown_train rows in both arms.
quality_selection_control.quality_policy: Within each filename camera stratum sample without replacement using the frozen B quality score as the monotonic sampling weight; this is source-group diversity, not verified session diversity.
quality_selection_control.uniform_policy: Uniform sample without replacement from the same candidate pool, with identical per-identity and camera-stratum counts and no quality cutoff.
quality_selection_control.limit: This D-owned supplement does not alter B's canonical role manifests and is separately hashed.

exports.host_checkpoint: Keras HDF5 weights plus source/config/curve/training summary per root
exports.quantized_export: Full-integer INT8 TFLite using representative samples from permitted train rows only; require integer input/output and audit all operators

final_role_gate: No final role is opened until matrix selection, per-root checkpoints/exports, calibration, gallery counts and model/config/calibration/protocol hashes are frozen. All SurvFace public scores are exploratory because K01-K05 appeared in v3 development.
prospective_limits: SurvFace rows are 96x96 public grayscale crops; source camera labels are not capture sessions.
Olivetti is a separate small-data, posed-face sanity set; no open-set or camera-session claim.
H5 published checkpoint class metadata and exact pretraining-data/licensing declaration are not embedded in the file; record this provenance limit instead of asserting an unverified source corpus.
Host TFLite quality does not qualify Nicla arena, OpenMV operator support, latency, power or camera pipeline.
